# Jeremiah 40 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 40:1 (overlap: 15%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-word which came to Jeremiah from-YHWH after Nebuzaradan [the]-captain-of [the]-guard had-sent-him from-Ramah, when-he-took-him and-he [was]-bound in-chains among-all the-exiles-of Jerusalem and-Judah who-were-being-exiled to-Babylon. |
| LOGOS | The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he took him bound in chains along with all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were being exiled to Babylon. |
| PNEUMA | The LORD spoke to Jeremiah after Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, released him at Ramah. Jeremiah had been found among the captives from Jerusalem and Judah who were being sent into exile in Babylon, bound in chains. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
